schema.description: Crest (coronamiento) of each deposit's main dam. One feature per deposit; several dam segments go in one MultiLineString. Geometry in WGS84 (lon, lat). v1 assumes a static crest over 2019-2026.

required_properties.deposit_id: string, must match an id in configs/deposits.geojson

optional_properties.source: string, how the line was drawn (e.g. digitised on Sentinel-2 2024-01 RGB, Sernageomin plan)
optional_properties.reference_date: string YYYY-MM-DD, date of the imagery or plan used
